messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "do not have live vaccine without doctor's approval"
set: ["do not have live vaccine without doctor's approval", "do not change dose without doctor's advice", "do not start or stop without doctor's advice", "do not change doses or stop without doctor's advice", "do not stop using asthma medication without doctor's advice", "do not change doses or medication schedule without doctor's advice", "do not give to a child without a doctor's advice", "do not start or stop during pregnancy without doctor's advice", "avoid live vaccine unless doctor says it is safe", "do not give to anyone younger than 18 years old without doctor's advice", "do not switch to schedule without doctor", "do not switch without doctor changing dose", "avoid close contact with someone who has had oral or nasal live vaccine", "do not start new medication without telling doctor", "do not give to child without medical advice", "do not stop without first talking to doctor"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
